name: vibe-studio
description: Clips, thumbnails and ads from your content. /clips turns a long video (file or link) into captioned, face-tracked vertical clips. /thumbnail turns a video into 3 ready-to-upload YouTube thumbnails. /ad turns a product photo into 5 short vertical video ads plus ad copy. Free voiceovers, original music, 3D motion and sound design, all local; no API keys, no payments.
